mentions.name: MCP Router
mentions.description: MCP Router is a free desktop app (Windows/Mac) for securely managing local or remote MCP servers via a GUI, with access control and logs. It works with VSCode, Cursor, Cline, and any MCP client, and connects to servers from any registry (Zapier, Smithy, etc.).
mentions.audience: MCP client users working in VSCode, Cursor, Cline, and similar tools
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working hard on MCP Router. MCP Router is a free desktop app (Windows/Mac) that lets you securely manage local or remote MCP servers via GUI, with access control & logs.
